351735.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Sales: the tooltip names the month and its revenue (e.g. Jul 2026, Revenue: $2,030,953), the same as the dashboard's Revenue chart for that month.
  • Service Advisor Analysis: the tooltip lists every advisor's percent with that advisor's ELR on the line below (e.g. the advisor's name: 117%, ELR: $172.25).
  • Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization: the tooltip lists every technician in the legend with that month's percent, one entry per drawn line and nothing else.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9583 (Story 11, Chart on the Report Page); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 11. The tooltip contents are from the design. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 10_sales_Hover, 11_saa_Hover, 12_te_Hover and 13_tu_Hover.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R7: “The embedded chart shows the same figures as the report it sits on.”
  • S9-R5: “When the user hovers a point on the Billing Efficiency chart, the tooltip shows that advisor's billing efficiency percent and that advisor's ELR dollar amount.”
  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”

  6. Repeat the last four steps on the Technician Utilization tile.
